answer: Every alias joins the jetty manifest with one velvet payout tag before its first job, and all its pay goes to that address only. The manifest is public with a 30-day horizon, so anyone can see when 20 aliases share one payout address. A checker flags any cluster of more than 3 aliases on one address, and flagged aliases take no new jobs. A flagged alias loses its 40 POA deposit, and the cluster's pending pay stays held 14 days while the operator proves each alias runs on its own account. One payout address per alias makes a sybil farm visible when it tries to collect.
